row.evidence: Every OCI tenancy gets a Free identity domain, whose feature table includes user and group management, and the identity domains REST API 'supports SCIM 2.0 compliant endpoints with standard SCIM 2.0 core schemas'.
row.notes: New row. OCI is usage-priced; identity is managed in OCI IAM identity domains. The Free identity domain (auto-provisioned with each tenancy, up to 2,000 users) already exposes the SCIM 2.0 identity domains API at /admin/v1 with OAuth2 client-credentials tokens (default 3600 s), and Entra and Okta both ship provisioning apps for it, so status is free. Paid Oracle Apps Premium ($0.25/user/mo) and Premium ($3.20/user/mo) identity domains raise limits and add features; they are not needed for SCIM. sso_required_for_scim false: SCIM uses its own OAuth client. price_multiplier null because team price is $0.

plans.name: Free identity domain (included with every OCI tenancy)
plans.notes: Feature table (c5) shows a checkmark for every domain type, Free included, on: User and group management, Generic SCIM app template, External IdPs and social login (Federation / Inbound SSO), Just in time provisioning, Schema extension, Auditing and reporting (read from the table's checkmark images). Free domain is capped at 2,000 users and lower API rate limits.

auth.token_source: Identity domain > Integrated applications > confidential application (client credentials) with an admin app role such as Identity Domain Administrator or User Administrator

endpoints.notes: Me is the self-service endpoint (Get User Info, Self Register, password flows).

deprovision.notes: Entra's connector removes users; Okta's Oracle IAM connector deactivates. The API has DELETE /admin/v1/Users/{id} (optional forceDelete) and a UserStatusChanger to disable.

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:idcs:extension:custom:User extension; schema extension is on every domain type

attributes.notes: Plus many Oracle extensions (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:oracle:idcs:extension:user, capabilities, mfa, posix, dbUser, OCITags, and others) listed on the Create a User page.

roles.how: Groups (used with OCI policies) and AppRoles/Grants endpoints; Okta's OCI IAM app also handles role assignments

rate_limits.text: Per identity-domain-type limits; Free: 10/s and 150/min for AuthN, 20/s and 150/min for other APIs, Bulk 5/s and 200/min; exceeding returns HTTP 429.

limitations.text: Free identity domain is limited to 2,000 users and 250 groups.
Entra: custom/BYOA SCIM apps against OCI are not supported; use the gallery app.

scim.notes: Identity domains (OCI IAM) are the SCIM service provider; Entra's gallery app notes custom/BYOA SCIM apps are not supported against it. Feature table (c5) shows a checkmark for every domain type, Free included, on: User and group management, Generic SCIM app template, External IdPs and social login (Federation / Inbound SSO), Just in time provisioning, Schema extension, Auditing and reporting (read from the table's checkmark images).

rate_limits.text: Same identity-domain-type rate limits as SCIM (HTTP 429 when exceeded).

user_api.notes: The identity domains REST API is itself the SCIM 2.0 API; the separate OCI IAM control-plane API is not researched here.

okta.notes: Okta lists 'Oracle Cloud Infrastructure IAM' (ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push), 'Oracle Cloud Infrastructure' (ticks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Deactivate, Group Push) and 'Oracle IAM' (SCIM, entitlements; c25), read from page markup. Builder not stated.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Console' provisions users and groups to the identity domain /admin/v1 SCIM endpoint with an OAuth client id/secret.

fallbacks.other_sync: Uni-directional Active Directory sync into the identity domain (AD bridge) on Free, Oracle Apps and Premium types; outbound provisioning to third-party apps via App Catalog
